title: Cottage in a Japanese Garden in East Nashville
description:
Enchanting brand new cottage nestled in a Japanese inspired garden, located in the heart of East Nashville! This is a 1 bedroom, 1 1/2 bath two-story bungalow with a private patio, washer/dryer, queen sleeper sofa, kitchen and Wifi / Sling TV. The space is a just a short walk from many popular restaurants, such as Rosepepper, Two Ten Jack, Wild Cow, Eastland Cafe, Pomadoro, Roze Cafe and others!

The space
This charming cozy cottage is a brand new construction.  It is a two-story space.  There is a bedroom with a full bathroom upstairs.  The main floor has a sleeper sofa, washer/dryer, kitchen and a half bath.  The real gem of this listing is the beautiful and peaceful Japanese garden surrounding the cottage.  Enjoy a cup of coffee or a glass of wine on the private patio while taking in the calming, serene energy of the surrounding beauty.  This is truly a diamond getaway right in a historic part of East Nashville.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire cottage and surrounding garden.  There is free parking on the street.

Other things to note
The property is home to 2 outdoor cats that you may or may not see on the grounds.  They are friendly but skittish, and probably won't let you get near them.
